summary: Connect blue pixels diagonally, and if the diagonal line passes through a magenta pixel, extend perpendicular diagonal lines from that magenta pixel.
path: diagonal line connecting s.pixel1 to s.pixel2
trajectory: paint blue along diagonal path between the two blue pixels
multi_step: Step 1: draw diagonal line connecting blue pixels; Step 2: for each magenta pixel on the diagonal, draw perpendicular diagonal lines extending to grid boundaries
src2: magenta pixels that lie on the blue diagonal line s
path2: perpendicular diagonal directions (90 degree rotation from original diagonal) from s until grid boundary
trajectory2: paint magenta along both perpendicular diagonal directions
